Some wide display formulae are only partly visible in their initial horizontal math-box position. This review does not claim every formula endpoint is visible simultaneously or prove scroll interaction from a static image.

The separate actual CMDP mobile endpoint receipt checks two inline theorem formula scrollers. That interaction receipt does not turn the screenshot review into a new all-equation or all-page interaction test.
The original browser report still has its historical visualInspection pending fields. This separate additive review records actual image inspection without rewriting any original execution or report.
